run_soccer_viewer: run the interactive MuJoCo soccer viewer with a BOXHEAD walker and default settings
run_soccer_viewer_with_ant: run the soccer viewer using the ANT walker type instead of the default BOXHEAD
run_soccer_viewer_with_humanoid: run the soccer viewer using the HUMANOID walker type for exploration
run_soccer_viewer_no_contacts: run the soccer viewer with walker-walker contacts disabled for isolated agent testing
run_soccer_viewer_terminate_on_goal: run the soccer viewer so the episode terminates automatically when a goal is scored
